answer_1.quote: Text style transfer is an essential topic of natural language generation ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences in the target style

answer_2.quote: Both self-BLEU and ref-BLEU are used for content preservation evaluations ... we train a 5-gram language model ... to measure the language fluency by the perplexity (PPL) of transferred sentence.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three annotators who have high-level language skills for human evaluation ... annotators are required to score sentences from 1 to 5, in terms of each aspect, i.e. style transfer accuracy (Sty), content preservation (Cont), and sentence fluency (Flu) ... they need to evaluate the consistency of the style words and other contexts ... Consistency is rated from 0 to 2.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score generated sentences on style transfer accuracy, content preservation, fluency, and consistency using specified rating scales.
